poc_summary: Objective: validate latency & cost for customer-facing chat and reranking flows.
Setup: hosted API + small Dedicated trial (single GPU) for elected traffic windows.
Findings: caching + batching recommendations reduced token spend by ~18%; Dedicated expected to reduce unit cost further with committed capacity.
Risk: peak-day traffic caused cost spike on hosted; need clear burst guardrails for Dedicated.
Next POC: 2-week Dedicated trial with canary routing and ramp schedule (requested).
pricing_needs: Commit levels: prefer 12-month commit with quarterly checkpoints; initial commit target ~15M tokens/mo equivalent.
Ramp schedule: 25% month1, 50% month2, 75% month3, 100% by month4 (wants formal ramp credits if underutilized).
Burst: require guaranteed 2x burst pool for up to 30 days with predictable pricing or prepaid burst credits.
Overage: cap on per-month overage % with tiered discount vs list price; finance team: 'need predictability, not surprise bills.'
Billing: prefer monthly invoicing with committed/usage split line items; visibility into token-level spend via Console.
Termination/credits: request pro-rated credits for downtime > SLA; legal flagged auto-renewal terms.
